messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Added **Deal name** inside **Reproduce a game**. Names now save and return when progress loads. Fixed pasted saves failing because their JSON fields were reordered; existing saves remain supported.

All work was delegated as requested. Type checking, 145 unit/CLI tests, and 84 browser journeys passed.

Changed files pass formatting. The full formatting check flags 13 pre-existing files, documented in [README](/work/README.md).
